title: Iitaka conjecture C_{n,m} on subadditivity of Kodaira dimension
exact_target: Is the Kodaira dimension of a projective fibration at least the sum of those of its base and general fiber?

sources.citation: C. Birkar, Iitaka conjecture C\_\{n,m\} in dimension six, arXiv:0806.4413 [math.AG], 2008.
